summary: Iteration 51 — dynamic landing showcase (templates + tenants). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter51_landing_showcase.py (7 tests, all PASS) and ran a Playwright pass on the landing page signed-out and signed-in. Backend endpoints /api/public/landing/templates and /api/public/landing/tenants are correct, public, and reactive to POST/PATCH/DELETE on /api/apps. Frontend renders 8 niche cards + '16 industry templates' line, 4 showcase cards with real names, tags and LIVE/TEMPLATE badges, correct counts line, no admin controls, no broken images, no 'Maximum update depth' loops. 'View all tenants' routes to /login when signed out and /dashboard when signed in. Clicking a tenant card with a preview token opens /p/{token}. Only console errors are the expected 401s from the pre-login /auth/me probe.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py AppUpdateIn does not accept preview_enabled — the review request asked to 'flip status via PATCH /api/apps/{id}' with preview_enabled, but Pydantic silently drops unknown fields so the status will not flip that way. Consumers must use POST /api/apps/{id}/preview/toggle instead. Consider adding preview_enabled to AppUpdateIn for consistency (or explicitly document that only /preview/toggle mutates it). Not a landing bug — endpoint output is correct — but a minor API surface inconsistency.

landing_cms.py public_tenants: preview_token is exposed publicly whenever preview_enabled is true (by design), so anyone hitting /api/public/landing/tenants can enumerate live preview URLs. This is intentional per spec but worth flagging as a security-review item.
landing_cms.py still uses DEFAULTS with hardcoded card list for the legacy /public/landing endpoint — landing page no longer uses it but the constant is dead code; safe to remove.
seed_data_creation: test_iter51_* throwaway app created and deleted by the auto-sync test — no residual data.
